arrival_cloud_reference.description: fraction: Public extrapolation reference, not the hidden weather target.

arrival_cloud_slope.description: fraction/second: Minimum observed cloud growth for an arrival estimate.

arrival_cloud_threshold.description: fraction: Minimum observed cloud level for an arrival estimate.

arrival_high_factor.description: multiplier: Upper-window factor applied to the estimate.

arrival_high_margin_seconds.description: seconds: Extra margin for the upper arrival estimate.

arrival_high_minimum_seconds.description: seconds: Minimum upper arrival window endpoint.

arrival_low_factor.description: multiplier: Lower-window factor applied to the estimate.

arrival_low_minimum_seconds.description: seconds: Minimum lower arrival window endpoint.

history_seconds.description: seconds: Public observation window for a trend anchor.

horizon_laps.description: reference laps: Forecast horizon before applying time bounds.

maximum_water_slope.description: fraction/second: Clamp for observed water slope.

minimum_trend_seconds.description: seconds: Minimum age of public trend evidence.

rain_visible.description: fraction: Observed-rain threshold shared by public messaging and weather policy.

spread_per_second.description: fraction/second: Horizon contribution to the spread.

spread_without_history.description: fraction: Extra spread when evidence is insufficient.

trend_gain.description: multiplier: Extrapolation weight for measured water trend.

trend_threshold.description: fraction/second: Minimum slope magnitude for a wetting/drying label.

braking_temperature_c.description: Celsius/normalized distance: Extra contact heating at full braking.

dry_water_clearance.description: fraction/normalized distance: Water displaced by a dry-family tyre.

dust_clearance.description: fraction/normalized distance: Dust displaced by contact.

marbles_clearance.description: fraction/normalized distance: Rubber debris cleared by contact.

outside_marbles.description: fraction/normalized distance: Debris deposited on the outside strip.

push_marbles_factor.description: multiplier: Outside-debris multiplier at push pace.

rubber_deposit.description: fraction/normalized distance: Rubber deposited by passage, reduced quadratically by water.

temperature_gain_c.description: Celsius/normalized distance: Contact heating without braking.

temperature_limit_c.description: Celsius: Contact-heating ceiling; must cover initial and environment target temperatures.

wet_water_clearance.description: fraction/normalized distance: Water displaced by a wet-family tyre.

width_strips.description: strips: Gaussian contact footprint width; grid resolution remains code-owned.

drainage_camber.description: multiplier: Signed camber contribution to longitudinal drainage.

evaporation_base.description: fraction/second: Evaporation at the reference temperature.

evaporation_temperature.description: fraction/second/Celsius: Temperature-dependent evaporation; total cannot become negative at 0 C.

rain_maximum.description: multiplier: Upper clamp for local rainfall modulation.

rain_minimum.description: multiplier: Lower clamp for local rainfall modulation.

rain_threshold.description: fraction: Local rain threshold for reduced evaporation and wet temperature target.

rain_time_radians.description: radians/second: Time frequency of rainfall modulation.

temperature_response.description: per second: Surface temperature interpolation response.

water_drainage_base.description: multiplier: Base drainage in addition to square-root water depth.

wet_evaporation.description: multiplier: Evaporation multiplier above the rain threshold.

base.description: multiplier: Clean-surface grip before rubber, water and contamination.

maximum.description: multiplier: Maximum grip and normalization of the grip overlay.

rubber_gain.description: multiplier: Dry rubber gain; reduced quadratically by water.

wet_rubber_threshold.description: fraction: Water threshold for rubber becoming a grip penalty.

adjacent_debris_factor.description: multiplier: Debris deposited on adjacent stations.

debris.description: fraction: Debris deposited by the existing incident paths.

oil.description: fraction: Oil deposited when the incident qualifies.

oil_health_threshold.description: health points: Oil qualification threshold for incident contamination.

dry_water.description: fraction: Initial line water for dry and changeable sessions.

dust_per_strip.description: fraction/strip: Dust added for each strip away from the centre; total must fit [0,1].

marbles.description: fraction: Initial rubber debris on every strip.

rubber.description: fraction: Initial rubber on each strip.

wet_threshold.description: fraction: Initial water threshold for choosing wet temperature.

wet_water.description: fraction: Initial line water for wet sessions.

advection_per_second.description: per second: Slope-driven lateral water movement; conservative exchange is still bounded by code.

camber_factor.description: multiplier: Camber contribution to lateral runoff.

diffusion_per_second.description: per second: Pairwise water diffusion rate.

changeable_heavy_rain.description: fraction: Heavy rainfall inside the inner changeable-training window.

changeable_light_rain.description: fraction: Light rainfall inside the outer changeable-training window.

minimum_race_seconds.description: seconds: Lower bound on the reference duration used to scale training windows.

wet_dry_seconds.description: race seconds: Wet-training dry boundary, not earlier than easing.

wet_ease_seconds.description: race seconds: Wet-training easing boundary; non-race phases retain heavy rain.

wet_eased_rain.description: fraction: Rainfall between wet-training easing and dry boundaries.

wet_heavy_rain.description: fraction: Rainfall before the wet-training easing boundary.

cloud_response_per_second.description: fraction/second: Maximum cloud movement toward the hidden target.

initial_cloud_changeable_base.description: fraction: Base initial cloud in changeable sessions.

initial_cloud_changeable_span.description: fraction: Uniform initial-cloud jitter; a draw is retained when zero.

initial_cloud_dry.description: fraction: Initial observed cloud in a dry session.

initial_cloud_wet.description: fraction: Initial observed cloud in a wet session.

initial_rain_wet.description: fraction: Initial rainfall in a wet seeded session; dry/changeable start at zero.

rain_cloud_gain.description: multiplier: Gain applied above the cloud threshold, before clamping rainfall to [0,1].

rain_cloud_threshold.description: fraction: Cloud level above which rain is generated.

rain_response_per_second.description: fraction/second: Maximum rainfall movement per simulated second.

target_dry_base.description: fraction: Base cloud target for dry sessions; dry rainfall stays zero.

transition_base_seconds.description: seconds: Minimum time between cloud-target choices.

transition_span_seconds.description: seconds: Uniform transition-duration jitter; base plus span cannot exceed 145.

fallback_damage.description: damage points: Above this level existing damage recovery takes precedence.

fallback_tread.description: tread percent: Below this level the existing resource/recovery policy takes precedence.

maximum_case_loss_factor.description: multiplier: Maximum accepted worst-case loss relative to pit loss.

minimum_case_gain_seconds.description: seconds: Robust case gain sufficient to consider a discretionary stop.

model_allowance_seconds.description: seconds: Uncalibrated model allowance around case outcomes and gains.

moderate_tread.description: tread percent: Moderate-risk threshold in crossover evaluation.

nominal_gain_seconds.description: seconds: Minimum nominal gain for the less-conservative alternative criterion.

nominal_pit_loss_factor.description: multiplier: Nominal gain required relative to modeled pit loss.

rain_warning_water.description: fraction: Rain-arrival notice is relevant below this mean water.

review_seconds.description: seconds: Base delegated-weather review interval; four-way staggering is code-owned.

safe_tread.description: tread percent: High-risk threshold used for set comparison and crossover evaluation.

slick_warning_water.description: fraction: Warn a slick-tyre runner above this peak line water.

traffic_seconds_per_car.description: seconds/car: Coarse public-traffic allowance in crossover scoring.

wet_warning_water.description: fraction: Warn a wet-tyre runner below this mean line water.

wettest_sector_factor.description: multiplier: Observed wettest-sector contrast retained by the coarse model.
